question: 能否直接讓 Tripo 以 face_limit=3500 原生輸出符合 3500 三角面預算的模型？
documented_semantics: Maximum output polycount; smart_low_poly=true triangle range 500–20000; quad=false requests triangles
measurement: Both direct GLB index accessor count / 3 and Blender calc_loop_triangles agree; one mesh and one mesh instance; original download has not been decimated.
interpretation: 3500 is a supported request value and was received, but this H3.1 smart-low-poly output exceeds it. Root cause unknown; do not infer universal parameter ineffectiveness or a guaranteed face count from two single-cat trials.

visual_review.finding: 主要輪廓相近，臉部與鬚片仍有差異。保留原生貼圖/材質/法線，沒有將此前修色版混入原生對照。尚未達 cat.png 美術驗收。

next_workflow: Native 3500 first, then inspect exported triangles/appearance/anatomy. If accepted, skip decimation. If rejected, diagnose provider discrepancy and evaluate bounded retopology/decimation fallback with its own appearance and deformation checks.
local_fallback: 14-budget-3500/balanced-v002 has exactly 3500 triangles, but region protection is case-specific and does not prove unseen-cat automation.
